notes.notes:
Whilst you wait for the game, help yourself to the novel which it is based on... https://www.blurb.ca/b/11710379-valravn

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43862193/40260b0052b19342c07d85da0f3f530315d48c0a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43862193/ccb3554bec46ee7609719281c208bd5f240fb169.png[/img][/url]

The game mechanics are halfway complete, which are aimed to deliver an authentic connection to the author's depiction of the main character [i]Anna Beqbaccar
[/i]
Currently, work on the game is paused and will resume sometime in October.
Sign up for the newsletter at [url=https://connecting.studio/?page_id=279[/url] to learn of progress and news of the game.
